title: Quest Foglight for Databases ForgeMBeanServerSupport Missing Authentication Remote Code Execution… (CVE-2026-92188)
description: CVE-2026-92188 is a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases. It affects the ForgeMBeanServerSupport module, which lacks authentication controls. This allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges on affected installations.
